description: This file defines the 'ViewLeaveEntitlementController' class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing the view and data preparation for leave entitlements, including handling employee info, leave types, and periods, and integrating permissions and access controls.

classes.name: ViewLeaveEntitlementController
classes.description: Controller for viewing leave entitlements, handling data loading and permission checks, extending AbstractVueController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and UI components for rendering the leave entitlement view, handling employee access, leave type, and leave period properties.

methods.name: addLeaveTypeProp
methods.description: Adds the leave type property to the component if leaveTypeId is provided in the request.

methods.name: addLeavePeriodProp
methods.description: Adds the leave period property to the component based on request parameters or defaults to the current leave period.
